Name: Zacchaeus
Summary: Zacchaeus was a wealthy chief tax collector in Jericho, short in stature, who climbed a sycamore tree to see Jesus. Jesus invited Himself to Zacchaeus's house, and salvation transformed his finances and heart that day.
KeyStory: Zacchaeus announced he would give half his possessions to the poor and repay anyone he had cheated four times over.
LifeLesson: Jesus said salvation had come to Zacchaeus's house because the Son of Man came to seek and save the lost. If you feel small, hidden, or far off, Jesus is calling you by name to come down and come home.
